title: Mushroom sauce for steak - with wine
preamble:
1 small onion

140g mushrooms , quartered

2 thyme sprigs, leaves removed

150ml red wine

1 tbsp butter Add
method: Fry the steak as normal in a pan. Remove and set aside
Add the onion, mushrooms and thyme leaves to the pan, then cook for a couple of mins until softened and golden.
Pour in the wine and bubble until syrupy, then turn off the heat and stir in the butter.
Serve the steaks with the mushroom sauce poured over.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
